|lore=Dispatched to Tatooine to apprehend renegade droids fleeing the ''Tantive IV''. Suspected to have misgivings about Imperial methods. Allegedly shot his commander in the back.
|game_text=During your control phase, may take (or lose 1 Force to retrieve) one Local Trouble or Look Sir, Droids into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent may not fire weapons during Local Trouble battles.

|notes=The Players Committee remaster for Trooper Davin Felth gives official wording dated 4 December 2006. See [[Trooper Davin Felth (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|Original]] for the earlier presentation. Both versions allow one named search or a 1-Force loss to retrieve the named card during the control phase. The take-into-hand arrow applies to the Reserve Deck search. The separate retrieval takes the card from Lost Pile. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 period One Rule] applies to the singular action.
